prompt:
Subject: A genotype represented by paired alleles.

Composition: Show a student examining two matching chromosome models placed side by side, each with the same gene location highlighted. Put A on the highlighted site of one chromosome and a on the other, with a small paired Aa tile directly beneath them; add no trait prediction.

Style: Use the attached invidious.png for drawing style only. Match its thick rounded dark-brown contours, simplified rounded shapes, and restrained 2D cartoon shading. Do not copy the reference subject or composition.

Framing: One compact composition, with the complete subject using about 80-90% of the square. Keep all limbs and object tips inside the frame.

Output: 512x512 PNG, RGBA, genuine transparent background and transparent gaps. Allow only A and a at the corresponding gene sites and Aa on the paired tile as essential allele notation. No other letters, captions, speech balloons, logos or watermark.
en: A student compares matching chromosome models with alleles A and a at the same gene location and an Aa pair below.
ja: 生徒が同じ遺伝子位置にAとaの対立遺伝子を持つ染色体模型を比べ、その下にAaの組を示す。
